ev.q: During 2017–2018, 8.2% of adults aged ≥18 years took medication to help fall or stay asleep
increased with age from 3.8% among those aged 18–44 years to 10.7% among those aged ≥65 years
8.2% of adults aged ≥18 years took medication to help fall or stay asleep
Among men, the percentage who took medication for sleep four or more times in the past week increased with age
Across all age groups, the percentage was higher among women than men.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population

methods_quotes.q: With 95% confidence intervals indicated by error bars.
